The Anafi has a gimbal-stabilized 21-megapixel camera capable of shooting 4K high-dynamic-range (HDR) video, which features a Sony IMX230 sensor and "lossless" digital zoom capable of 1.4× zoom in 4K mode and 2.8× zoom in 1080p mode.

raw_candidates.quote: IR image chain — Sensor: FLIR BOSON

The Anafi has a gimbal-stabilized 21-megapixel camera capable of shooting 4K high-dynamic-range (HDR) video, which features a Sony IMX230 sensor and "lossless" digital zoom capable of 1.4× zoom in 4K mode and 2.8× zoom in 1080p mode.

attempts.notes: Parrot's own ANAFI USA spec page confirms the thermal sensor is a FLIR Boson (and the visible chain is two 1/2.4" 21MP sensors), but it does not name the visible-spectrum sensor vendor; the Sony IMX230 identification comes from Wikipedia's account of the base Anafi, which uses the same 1/2.4" 21MP camera, so it is not USA-model-specific. No public teardown or filing I opened identified the Anafi USA's visible sensor, and I found no source stating where either sensor is fabricated, so tier 2 is empty.
